reference: Unmodified original interactive symmetric creation. Actual constructor entry/static-return observers capture parsed descriptor and every defined geometry store. SMIN/WMIN cases use actual technology files. Nonzero-SMIN polygons retain their preceding ordinary keyword command and repeated maximum-zero prompt history; a data-only sscanf observer stops observation after 1200 calls, then terminates the captured inferior. This is an observation limit, not a claim of native termination. Numerical instructions, inputs and allocator behavior are not patched.
